manifest.title: Synthetic Ticket reliability fixture
manifest.objective: Synthetic, read-only adaptation of 17 waypoints. No source roadmap is executed or mutated.
notes: Synthetic adaptation. Mission API predecessor checkpoints encode rendered order and do not assert source-roadmap prerequisites.
Fixture-authored outcome plans and synthetic local evidence are not requester approvals or real execution evidence.

outcome_plan.expected_outcome: Blank writes fail while valid part content and state rules remain stable.

alternative_outcomes.outcome: A whitespace-only payload reaches a transport path not covered by the first check.
acceptable_handling: Record the condition as fixture-authored guidance, preserve all source bytes, and stop any affected follow-up.

waypoints.prompt: Fixture-only adaptation: Reject blank Ticket-part content and preserve settled lifecycle constraints for writes. Preserve the boundary: Keep the contract narrow; transaction recovery and migration are separate work.
non_goals: Do not change unrelated lifecycle states.

validation.command: Run focused Ticket API validation and inspect empty, whitespace, and valid part cases.
